newsitem.title: UK: Siebe launches industrial air compressor.
newsitem.headline: Siebe launches industrial air compressor.

text.p: British engineering group Siebe Plc said on Thursday its CompAir BroomWade unit launched an energy-efficient rotary screw air compressor for industrial uses.
The Cyclon SR offers a 25-percent plus energy saving over conventional compressors by consuming exactly the amount of energy required for jobs -- and no more, Siebe said in a statement.
Siebe said the compressor would cost more than its conventional counterparts, but cost savings should pay the difference within a year. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
